title: Incoming delta that touches a historical 64-character native claim records its hold instead of rolling back
outcome: Incoming delta that touches a historical 64-character native claim records its hold instead of rolling back
acceptance: An incoming task-sync delta that touches a task whose active native claim has a historical 64-character event id is deferred with that id stored unchanged, instead of rolling back the exchange; newly minted hold and exchange identities stay UUIDs.
A behavior test with a real historical 64-character claim id defers, replays exactly, survives projection rebuild and passes doctor, with no weakening of authority checks or foreign-record isolation.

completion.summary: Preserve historical native claim IDs when incoming deltas defer, with unchanged hold/exchange UUID and authority guards. Added real claim deferral, replay, projection rebuild and doctor regression; checked exact clean candidate handed to parent for combined review and landing.
